sampling_coordinate_transition.v2_access: IRI monthly v2 OPeNDAP, latitude centres and reported X edge coordinates
sampling_coordinate_transition.v3_access: Native monthly final v3 raster pixel centres
sampling_coordinate_transition.note: Comparison is against the exact previously published v2 series, not a newly resampled v2 raster; changes cannot be attributed solely to v3.

comparison.interpretation: Before/after published-series comparison with unchanged nominal boxes and statistical method. The legacy IRI v2 X axis reports edge-aligned longitudes and includes an additional column per box; v3 uses native pixel centres. Differences include both the product change and this sampling-coordinate convention change. This is not independent station validation or evidence of forecast skill.
